items.text: If I was feeling generous I'd describe the in game audio as annoying, the music as instantly muteworthy, the UI as unintuitive, the voice acting as grating, and the overall art direction as just generally very ugly and unappealing in any way. As I'm not feeling generous, I'll describe it overall as a complete and total waste of your money.
items.text_zh: 如果我心情宽厚一点，我会把游戏内音效形容为烦人，把音乐形容为让人立刻想静音，把UI形容为不直观，把配音形容为刺耳，把整体美术方向形容为总体上非常丑陋、毫无吸引力。既然我心情并不宽厚，那我就把它整体形容为对你金钱的彻底、完全的浪费。
